units.states: blocks sorted by id; every state of the block; state is name=value pairs sorted by property name; parts lists, in file order, the indices into part_table of the parts that the state draws; missing marks a state with no model
units.display_table: each entry maps a display context to its transform: the nearest model of the chain that declares the context supplies it; rotation in degrees, translation in blocks after the clamp, scale after the clamp
units.seed_rule: absent: the position seed uses the position of the block; lower_half: the upper half uses the position one block below; bed_head: the foot uses the position of the head, one block in the facing direction, at its own y
units.part_table: each part is a weighted list of variants; x, y, z in degrees; weight as written, default 1
units.models: every model file plus the built-in models; geometry_from is the model that supplies the elements, absent for none; textures holds the resolved slots; unresolved lists the slots of the chain that resolve to no texture; display is an index into display_table, absent when no model of the chain declares a display context
units.picks: seed is the 64-bit position seed of the state at the position; chosen lists, per part of the state, the index of the variant in its weighted list
